[SWS_DM_01077] Clearing individual configured
DDDIDs
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04246
⌈
On reception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction 0x03 clear-
DynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier and one dynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier in the re-
quest, the DM shall clear the according
DDDID
from the request.
⌋
A cleared
DDDIDs
is considered as not configured. A request to read such a
DDDID
is
treated in the same way as a request to a static
DID
that is not configured.
